name: Online Indirect Illumination via Importance Sampling
definition: Computes indirect illumination (inter-reflections) online using importance sampling. Samples rays near the reflective direction w_r to capture indirect light, addressing limitations of caching methods in dynamic lighting.
summary: Online Indirect Illumination via Importance Sampling computes real-time inter-reflections by sampling rays near the view reflection, offering a low-memory alternative to caching for dynamic scenes with directional lighting.
